summary:
Implementation plan for redesigning the DSCWeb_React homepage to be clean, premium, and product-focused.
Consolidates repetitive sections into 4 distinct, purposeful sections:
- Section A: Refined Hero with Dark Skull Corporation eyebrow, clean headline, balanced subtext, primary/secondary CTAs, and removal of the 4-item capability strip.
- Section B: Featured Apps & Projects showcasing Calculator, QR Scanner | Generator, and Mind Matrix in a clean 3-column grid with working action buttons and a 'View All Apps' header link.
- Section C: Explore What DSC Offers featuring 3 core category cards (Apps & Utilities, Software Panels, Downloads & Tools) with direct routing.
- Section D: Compact Final CTA for technical support and inquiries without repeating the About/Contact page copy.
Preserves existing routes, theme colors, button styles, and responsive behaviors.
